findings.title: The process-spans command still defaults the flusher to one worker
findings.body: `flusher_processes` is always supplied by Click with a default of `1`, so `ProcessSpansStrategyFactory` passes `max_processes=1` and `SpanFlusher` assigns every Redis shard to a single flusher process. Consequently, normal `process-spans` deployments do not get the per-shard parallelism described by this change unless every deployment is separately updated to pass `--flusher-processes`; the new multiprocess flusher provides no throughput scaling by default. Default this option to the shard-derived behavior (for example `None`) or update the deployment configuration as part of this change.

findings.title: Negative flusher process counts are accepted and crash flusher initialization
findings.body: The new option uses `type=int` without a positive lower bound. Passing `--flusher-processes=-1` reaches `SpanFlusher`, which computes a negative `num_processes`, creates no entries in `process_to_shards_map`, and then raises a `KeyError` while assigning the first shard. This turns an invalid command-line value into an unhelpful consumer startup crash. Validate this option as an integer greater than zero (and define the intended behavior for zero).
